+++ b/src/_pytest/stub_module_names.py
@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def stub_module_name_from_path(path: Path, root: Path) -> str:
+    """
+    Return a dotted module name for the given ``.pyi`` stub path, anchored on root.
+
+    This mirrors :func:`_pytest.pathlib.module_name_from_path`, but strips a
+    ``.pyi`` suffix instead of a ``.py`` one.
+
+    For example: path="projects/src/pkg/foo.pyi" and root="/projects", the
+    resulting module name will be "src.pkg.foo".
+    """
+    if path.suffix == ".pyi":
+        path = path.with_suffix("")
+    try:
+        relative_path = path.relative_to(root)
+    except ValueError:
+        # If we can't get a relative path to root, use the full path, except
+        # for the first part ("d:\\" or "/" depending on the platform, for example).
+        path_parts = path.parts[1:]
+    else:
+        # Use the parts for the relative path to the root path.
+        path_parts = relative_path.parts
+
+    # Module name for packages do not contain the __init__ file, unless
+    # the `__init__.pyi` file is at the root.
+    if len(path_parts) >= 2 and path_parts[-1] == "__init__":
+        path_parts = path_parts[:-1]
+
+    # Module names cannot contain ".", normalize them to "_".
+    path_parts = tuple(x.replace(".", "_") for x in path_parts)
+
+    return ".".join(path_parts)
diff --git a/testing/test_stub_module_names.py b/testing/test_stub_module_names.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..750ec3f46
--- /dev/null
+++ b/testing/test_stub_module_names.py
@@ -0,0 +1,44 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from _pytest.pathlib import module_name_from_path
+from _pytest.stub_module_names import stub_module_name_from_path
+
+
+class TestStubModuleNameFromPath:
+    def test_relative_to_root(self, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+        result = stub_module_name_from_path(
+            tmp_path / "src/tests/test_foo.pyi", tmp_path
+        )
+        assert result == "src.tests.test_foo"
+
+    def test_outside_root(self, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+        result = stub_module_name_from_path(
+            Path("/home/foo/test_foo.pyi"), Path("/bar")
+        )
+        assert result == "home.foo.test_foo"
+
+    def test_package_init(self, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+        result = stub_module_name_from_path(tmp_path / "src/app/__init__.pyi", tmp_path)
+        assert result == "src.app"
+
+    def test_init_at_root_is_kept(self, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+        result = stub_module_name_from_path(tmp_path / "__init__.pyi", tmp_path)
+        assert result == "__init__"
+
+    def test_dots_in_path_components(self, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+        result = stub_module_name_from_path(
+            tmp_path / ".env.310/src/my.pkg/mod.pyi", tmp_path
+        )
+        assert result == "_env_310.src.my_pkg.mod"
+
+    def test_only_pyi_suffix_removed(self, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+        result = stub_module_name_from_path(tmp_path / "src/foo.py", tmp_path)
+        assert result == "src.foo_py"
+
+    def test_matches_source_helper(self, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+        for rel in ("a/b/c", "a/__init__", ".x.y/z"):
+            assert stub_module_name_from_path(
+                tmp_path / f"{rel}.pyi", tmp_path
+            ) == module_name_from_path(tmp_path / f"{rel}.py", tmp_path)
